pr.title: fix: separate PosixShellType.Sh case with POSIX-safe single-quote escaping
pr.body:
#### What does this implement/fix?

POSIX `sh` does not support ANSI-C `$'...'` quoting. In `escapeNonWindowsPath`, `PosixShellType.Sh` was grouped with `Bash` and `Zsh`, and unknown shells used the same `$'...'` form for paths that contain both a single and a double quote. In `/bin/sh` (dash, for example) that is a syntax error.

`PosixShellType.Sh` now has its own case, and the default case uses the same quoting. Both use the POSIX close/escape/reopen idiom, so each `'` becomes `'\''`. Bash, Zsh and Git Bash keep `$'...'` for the both-quotes case.

This also changes `collapseTildePath` to check `startsWith(normalizedUserHome + '/')` (or equality) instead of `includes`, so `/home/user2` is not collapsed when home is `/home/user`, and `/tmp/backup/home/user/file` is not collapsed either.

#### Tests

- Separate `sh` test covering a single quote, a double quote and both.
- Updated Bash, Zsh, Git Bash and default-shell expectations.
- Two `collapseTildePath` cases for the substring and shared-prefix collisions.

I could not run the full suite locally. I checked every `escapeNonWindowsPath` expectation in the test file against the real function output (25 of 25 match).

#### AI usage disclosure

I used AI assistance for:
- Research and understanding

commit.message:
fix: separate PosixShellType.Sh case with POSIX-safe single-quote escaping

POSIX sh does not support ANSI-C $'...' quoting. When a path contains
a single quote, the existing code fell through to the Bash case and
emitted $'...\\'...' which sh rejects.

Fix: give PosixShellType.Sh its own case using close-quote/escaped-quote/
reopen-quote: path.replace(/'/g, "'\\''"). Also tighten collapseTildePath
to check startsWith(home + separator) so /home/user2 is not collapsed when
home is /home/user.

Add regression tests for both cases.

test: update shell-escaping assertions to match new quoting strategies

- Bash/Zsh/GitBash now use ANSI-C $'...' quoting for single-quote paths
- PosixShellType.Sh and unknown shells use POSIX close/escape/reopen
- Split bash/sh/zsh test into two suites (different output formats)
- Add Sh bothQuotes coverage for paths with both single and double quotes
- Update default-shell test to expect POSIX form
